1. Choose a launcher and install Holy Lois.
2. Open your launcher and choose Holy Lois: Reborn.
3. Multiplayer already has our server.

Offline players: /register PASSWORD PASSWORD once, /login PASSWORD later. At least five characters, no spaces.
